SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No. S. B. R. G.

Special Branch S. 2. XXXXXX
REPORT
Date March 21, 1935

Subject (in full) Wilhelm Zdiradow - character of.

Made by D.S. Jones    Forwarded by D.S.K.

With reference to the enquiry from the Netherlands
Consulate-General regarding the character of an Austrian citizen
named Wilhelm Zdiradow, I have to state that there is no mention
of such a person in Police records and that he has not come to
our notice before.

D.S.
D.S. Jones

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

日期：1935年3月21日

主题（全称）威廉·兹迪拉多夫（Wilhelm Zdiradow）——品行情况。

撰写人：D.S. 琼斯    转呈人：D.S.K.

关于荷兰总领事馆就一名名为威廉·兹迪拉多夫的奥地利公民的品行所提出的查询，本人谨声明，警方档案中并无此人的记录，且此前未引起我方注意。

特别处
副专员
D.S. 琼斯

pages.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

CONFIDENTIEEL

No. 1001.

SHANGHAI, 19th March 1935.

Sir,

I should be much obliged to you if you could let me know whether anything is known from a point of view of politics or morals concerning the Austrian citizen Wilhelm ZDIRADOW, manager of the Styria Steelworks, Vienna, which company is represented here by the former Austrian Consul Mr. F. Winkler (24 The Bund), who introduced the above person to me. Mr. Zdiradow was born at Bruenn, 16 October 1892, his Vienna address being Wien VIII, Schloesselgasse 5, whereas he is now staying in the Palace Hotel. He possesses an Austrian passport issued by the Austrian Consulate at Bruenn (which place is now on Tsechoslovakian territory) on 30 October 1928, No. 608.254-1631-28, and extended at Stuttgart on 4 November 1930 for a period ending 4 November 1935.

He stated to be travelling on business via Japan, Siam, the Strait Settlements and the Netherlands Indies to Europe and expected to arrive in Java about June of this year.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D.S. Givens.
S.M.B. 2073.

S 2, For attention please.
JPS
20 MAR 1935
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

机密

第1001号。

上海，1935年3月19日。

先生：

如蒙告知是否掌握有关奥地利公民威廉·兹迪拉多夫（Wilhelm ZDIRADOW）在政治或道德方面的任何情况，本人将不胜感激。兹迪拉多夫系维也纳施蒂里亚钢铁厂（Styria Steelworks）经理，该厂在此间由前奥地利领事F. 温克勒先生（外滩24号）代表，上述人员即由温克勒先生向本人介绍。兹迪拉多夫于1892年10月16日出生于布鲁恩（Bruenn），其在维也纳的住址为维也纳八区施洛塞尔巷5号（Wien VIII, Schloesselgasse 5），目前暂住华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）。他持有1928年10月30日由奥地利驻布鲁恩领事馆（该地现属捷克斯洛伐克领土）签发的奥地利护照，号码为608.254-1631-28，并于1930年11月4日在斯图加特延期，有效期至1935年11月4日。

他声称因公务途经日本、暹罗、海峡殖民地和荷属东印度前往欧洲，预计将于今年六月左右抵达爪哇。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
中文秘书。

T. P. 吉文斯 先生，
副专员（特别处），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D.S. 吉文斯。
S.M.B. 2073。

S 2，请予关注。
JPS
1935年3月20日
